title: Technical Support Coach
description:
The Tech Coach plays a pivotal role in elevating the skill set, confidence, and service delivery of our customer-facing support teams. Working within the Learning & Development (L&D) organization, the Tech Coach balances real-time technical guidance in internal support channels with structured quality checks, performance coaching, and documentation maintenance. This role acts as a strategic bridge between support technicians, supervisors, and training staff to ensure standard-setting customer experiences.

#### **Key Responsibilities**

* Provide real-time technical guidance and troubleshooting support in internal help channels.
* Guide technicians through complex or urgent customer issues by breaking down technical concepts and fostering problem-solving skills rather than simply providing direct answers.
* Instill confidence in frontline staff and set a high standard for customer interaction quality.
* Communicate with Operations and Engineering teams when new issues/bugs arise.
* Evaluate technician ticket, chat, and phone interactions against established QA/QC grading rubrics and automated grading checks.
* Perform monthly human verification audits on sample cases to maintain grading accuracy and calibrate evaluation systems.
* Conduct targeted manual case reviews for agents to isolate root causes and build remediation plans.
* Provide clear and useful feedback for administrators to improve customer service.
* Partner directly with leaders to deliver structured feedback, actionable performance insights, and trend analysis.
* Communicate both performance deficiencies and team accolades to leaders to aid in employee development and recognition.
* Participate in leadership syncs to align coaching priorities with team performance metrics.
* Draft, update, and maintain internal documentation articles to maintain brand consistency and availability of information.
* Identify missing or outdated documentation standard operating procedures during ticket reviews and update relevant sources.
* Assist with training, onboarding, and mentoring new technical hires as they transition onto active shifts.
* Serve as an approachable point of contact for new technicians during their early tenure to accelerate time-to-productivity.
* Drive technical advancement initiatives (e.g., Level 1 to Level 2/3 progression) by designing targeted coaching plans.
* Conduct 1-on-1 coaching sessions to address skill gaps, refine soft skills, and improve technical execution.
* Track recurring technical issues, error patterns, and support trends across shifts.
* Provide feedback and data insights to Trainers regarding widespread knowledge gaps to inform future training modules, team PSAs, and curriculum updates.

#### **Requirements**

* Strong proficiency in Web Hosting environments, Linux system administration, and command-line interfaces (CLI).
* Mastery of soft skills, with a demonstrated ability to explain complex technical topics in clear, approachable language.
* Friendly, positive, and energetic approach to mentoring peers and helping others succeed.
* Ability to review support cases, analyze performance data using rubric criteria, and draw objective conclusions.
* High comfort level working in fast-paced text and chat environments while balancing accuracy with responsiveness.

#### **Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience in technical coaching, mentoring, training, or QA role.
* Experience with specialized web hosting management tools.
* Familiarity with Salesforce CRM and QA evaluation tools.

title: Helpdesk Associate
description:
Position Overview

The Help Desk Associate provides front-line administrative and coordination support to the IT department. The role primarily involves answering incoming IT-related calls, recording user requests as tickets, and ensuring that requests are documented and routed to the appropriate support personnel. The position also assists with meeting scheduling, conference room arrangements, record maintenance, and other routine clerical and administrative activities to support the smooth day-to-day functioning of the department.

Duties and Responsibilities

* Answer incoming telephone calls to the IT department in a polite and professional manner.
* Record calls and user-reported issues as support tickets, ensuring that the details are clear and accurate.
* Categorize tickets and forward or assign them to the appropriate analyst or IT support team according to established procedures.
* Capture relevant details such as the caller’s name, department, contact information, and a brief description of the request or issue.
* Maintain call logs, ticket records, registers, and other trackers as required.
* Schedule meetings, coordinate invitations, and communicate meeting details to participants.
* Arrange conference rooms for meetings, including checking room availability and coordinating basic setup requirements.
* Assist with routine administrative tasks such as maintaining records, preparing simple documents, and handling correspondence as assigned.
* Coordinate with relevant staff to confirm meeting schedules, room bookings, and other logistical requirements.
* Direct calls or general enquiries to the appropriate person or department when required.
* Maintain confidentiality of internal information and handle user details responsibly.
* Perform other clerical and administrative duties assigned by the reporting manager.

Qualifications and Skills Required

Educational Qualifications

Higher Secondary education or a diploma/degree in any discipline. Qualifications in office administration, business administration, or computer applications are an added advantage.

Technical & Functional Skills

* Basic computer skills, including email, calendars, word processing, and spreadsheets.
* Ability to use ticketing systems or learn the department’s ticket logging procedures.
* Good data-entry accuracy and attention to detail.
* Basic meeting scheduling, calendar coordination, and record-keeping skills.

Core Competencies

* Clear verbal communication and professional telephone etiquette.
* Polite, patient, and service-oriented approach.
* Good organization, time management, and attention to detail.
* Ability to follow procedures and coordinate with different teams.
* Reliability, discretion, and willingness to support routine administrative needs.

Experience

0–2 years of experience in call handling, front-desk support, office administration, customer service, or a similar role. Freshers with good communication and basic computer skills may also be considered.

Experience in an IT department or a healthcare organization is an added advantage.
